title: Doom
description: At the end of the enemy turn, if it has at least as much Doom as HP, it dies.
smart_description: At the end of the {OnPlayer:player|enemy} turn, if [gold]{OwnerName}[/gold] has [blue]{Amount}[/blue] or less HP, it dies.
notes: A death-threat power: when the Doom counter reaches or exceeds the target's current HP, the creature dies at the end of its turn. The smart description updates to show the actual threshold dynamically.
